title: Authentication
summary: Email + password sign-in with server-side sessions (sign-out, deactivation, and a password change end them), layered sign-in limits, change your own password, and forgot-password by email; the frontend guard, sign-in and password pages, and the user menu. Fills the kernel's d.Auth.
when_to_use: Any app where people sign in with an email and password the app checks itself.
when_not_to_use: Sign-in only through SSO/OAuth/an identity provider.
Refresh tokens, 2FA, or passwordless sign-in are needed now — not in this version.

ports.name: UserStore
ports.description: Find a user's credentials (bcrypt hash, active flag) by email, and a user's profile by ID — with when their password last changed, if the store tracks it.

ports.name: PasswordWriter
ports.description: Replace a user's password once auth has checked who they are — for change-password and forgot-password. Without it both are off.

ports.name: Mailer
ports.description: Send one email — for the forgot-password link. Without it forgot-password is off.

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.description: Signs session tokens. Production: a random value of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32).

env.name: JWT_EXPIRES_IN
env.description: Session length as a Go duration (default 24h).

env.name: APP_URL
env.description: The address people open the app at (https://app.example.com) — reset links point here. Required in production when forgot-password is on.
